create_RolloutStorage: create a RolloutStorage instance to store rollout data for RL training with observations, actions, and rewards buffers
insert_rollout_data: insert next observations, actions, rewards, and masks into the RolloutStorage buffers at the current step index
compute_returns_GAE: compute discounted returns using GAE or simple Monte Carlo bootstrapping with gamma and tau parameters
recurrent_generator_mini_batch: generate shuffled mini-batches from rollout storage with RNN sequence build info for recurrent policy training
advance_rollout_step: advance the current rollout step index after inserting data for the next environment step
